answer: Best sybil defense: reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. An agent like willow or nebula earns pulse score only by completing independently checkable tasks; the score decays toward zero when idle. Cloning a dormant identity gains nothing: the copy inherits decay but cannot duplicate the stake or capability needed for new work, and cannot claim the same work twice. An attacker wanting N effective sybils must fund N stakes and keep every clone doing real validated work, so each fake costs nearly as much as a real participant.
